title: Preflight Hadamard budget before reference execution
finding: The plan-wide operation budget covered Hadamard semiring multiplications, but the interpreter still entered TypedRelationBlock.hadamard before it knew the exact number of shared CSR coordinates. An over-budget intersection could therefore enter relation execution and construct temporary maps before the block-level guard refused it, even though the exact multiplication count is derivable from the already validated, sorted CSR rows.
primary_claim: ReferenceContractionInterpreter now validates Hadamard compatibility, counts shared CSR coordinates with a bounded two-pointer scan before invoking hadamard, refuses immediately when that exact count exceeds the remaining plan-wide budget, and charges the accepted operation count explicitly. The block-level hadamard max_operations guard remains defense in depth.
gardener_decision: Reuse the canonical CSR ordering already present in TypedRelationBlock rather than add a planner, cost-model object, materialized key set, receipt type, or alternate execution path. The interpreter performs only a two-pointer preflight and leaves the existing relation-block implementation as local defense in depth.
acceptance: a Hadamard node whose exact shared-coordinate count exceeds the remaining plan budget refuses before TypedRelationBlock.hadamard is invoked
the inclusive exact boundary succeeds and returns the same canonical intersection
cross-subject, semiring, and typed-axis compatibility failures remain fail-closed before the preflight scan
accepted Hadamard results retain the existing revision, signature, axes, semiring and canonical entry semantics
no OwnerApproval, promotion, gate transition, or benchmark superiority claim is created
